protocol: FedBCert evidence-use freeze and exactly two targeted gap tasks

tasks.name: closest_certificate_comparability_and_frozen_instance_comparison
tasks.question: Does a closest published verifier have a genuinely comparable special case without changing the predictor or uncertainty set?
tasks.existing_evidence: E26 is implementation consistency on a strict known-universe subset, not an endpoint-blind performance ranking.
tasks.priority_external_candidate: RobLight; GNNev and the E26 exact oracle remain reference checks
tasks.instances: all 40 E26 frozen models and all 4 known-endpoint completions per model; no new instance search
tasks.allowed_extra_information: known-universe mode only, separately labelled; never passed to the endpoint-blind verifier
pre_execution_gate: pin official external source commit and dependencies in a new exclusive manifest before numeric comparison
use the existing E26 stored model/feature tensors or verify deterministic reconstruction against stored logits; never silently regenerate unverified inputs
check the same unperturbed logits and all 4 completion logits with absolute tolerance 1e-8
enumerate and prove the same known-universe candidate-edge, count, feature and self-loop semantics
label subset or superset encodings as diagnostic only, not same-threat rankings
freeze supported mode, timeout, memory budget, all-case order and analysis before execution
report: robust nonrobust unknown timeout and translation failures
precision and solved-instance ratio against the exact known-universe oracle
same-set comparison only if the equivalence gate passes
endpoint-blind coverage separately, as a strict superset guarantee
timings with matching boundaries, without an endpoint-blind speed ranking
tasks.hard_stop: If equivalence or official support cannot be established, archive that limitation and stop; do not train another predictor, change the uncertainty domain or sample easier models.
tasks.closure_without_positive_outcome: Retain existing bridge and source-backed interface distinctions; exclude claims of superiority to a stronger published verifier.

tasks.name: certificate_only_overhead_on_frozen_predictors
tasks.question: What is certification's measured added time and memory relative to inference on the same frozen model?

frozen_case_groups.source: E28b committed observed_p primary cell h0.90_rho0.40
frozen_case_groups.role: timing replay only, not a new independent confirmation
large-graph timing replay; verify reconstructable view before including

pre_execution_gate: verify checkpoint, protocol, local view, features, row order and ledger hashes
construct a label-free tensor input before invoking any measurement worker
never call training, test scoring or checkpoint selection functions
freeze environment, devices, dtype, sparse format and measurement ordering
use exactly the existing alpha, coefficients, model and certificate predicates
log an unavailable OGB view and stop that group rather than invent reconstruction equivalence

main_environment.dtype_scope: audit execution path; do not compare directly to historical float32 training time

measurement.stage_order: fixed rotation across repetitions, not choose the fastest order
measurement.timer: perf_counter with synchronize before and after every device stage if a GPU mode is separately frozen
report: per-case median p10 p90 and all raw repetitions
per-case combined-time to forward-time ratio using the same device and dtype
node count edge count polynomial terms hidden dimension class count
process RSS baseline peak and increment; separate worker per case and stage
GPU allocation peak only if GPU mode is independently frozen; never call it total GPU memory
output finite checks and input/model tensor digests unchanged

tasks.hard_stop: Any input mutation, hash mismatch, nonfinite value or resource breach ends the affected case and is recorded; no rerun until a faster or more favourable result appears.
tasks.closure_without_positive_outcome: Publish observed overhead or unavailable cases and retain only computational feasibility; low-overhead wording is not a required positive gate.

final_freeze_rule: After each task reaches executed-and-audited or an explicit negative/not-comparable/unavailable terminal outcome, freeze all outputs and claim scope. No further parameter search or positive-result campaign. A later correctness bug requires a transparent new revision, not silent replacement.
